data.exact_reserve_text: The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.

prior_year_events.impact_description: reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company. This will provide stability to the Syndicate on any future loss movements on the prior years. The premium cost to the Syndicate was GBP 28.0m which provided an equivalent reinsurance recovery.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1975 experienced a significant release of prior year reserves in 2021, primarily driven by favorable claims development on the 2018 and 2019 years of account. Reserves established in 2020, including those for COVID-19, proved adequate, leading to these releases. A Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) was put in place in December 2021, reinsuring loss reserves for the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which provided stability for future loss movements on these prior years.
